newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel wins Uzbek GSM contract.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel wins Uzbek GSM contract.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom said on Tuesday it had won a $60 million GSM contract by PT Bakrie Communication Corp (BCC) to supply Uzbekistan with the country's first digital mobile telecommunications network.
Alcatel will supply the network, on a turnkey basis, in the Tashkent and Samarkand urban areas. The first phase is scheduled to begin operation in Tashkent in the second quarter of 1997.
BCC is the telecoms arm of Indonesia's PT Bakrie & Brothers. It already runs fixed cellular networks in Indonesia and Vietnam.
